questions.table_column: Property at the original read position: table column. A = the first table column; B = a later table column.
questions.python_indent: Property at the original read position: python indent. A = one level of indentation; B = three levels of indentation.
questions.latex_subject: Property at the original read position: latex subject. A = algebra content; B = geometry content.
questions.prose_sentiment: Property at the original read position: prose sentiment. A = positive sentiment; B = negative sentiment.
questions.list_depth: Property at the original read position: list depth. A = a top-level list item; B = a third-level list item.
questions.prose_paren: Property at the original read position: prose paren. A = the read position inside a parenthesis; B = the read position outside any parenthesis.
questions.python_string: Property at the original read position: python string. A = an open string literal; B = a closed string literal.
questions.python_effect: Property at the original read position: python effect. A = an in-place list mutation; B = construction of a new list.
